info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trust Services Retrieval API
info.description: The Trust Services Retrieval API allows clients to access detailed information about trust services available for consumers. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions and service providers that need to retrieve specific trust service details using a unique identifier. Typical use cases include evaluating trust service options for clients, integrating trust data into financial applications, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. By utilizing this API, developers can seamlessly access and utilize trust services information to enhance consumer banking offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific trust service.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the detailed information related to a specific trust service identified by its unique resource ID. The response will include all relevant data regarding the trust service, which can be used for further processing or display in applications.
